title: Emergence — Ledger Record
description: The real, persisted record shape written by event-ledger/index.js's ledger:commit Gate -- content-addressed via vendor/jaa/FileStore.js (a real port of Jaa's persistence layer, see that file's header), hash-chained via 'prev'. rfr2's real UpgradeLedger still does the actual validation (requires proof) before this record is written -- this schema describes what gets stored, not the commit() call's input shape.

ts.description: real rfr2 UpgradeLedger timestamp, not this file's own clock.

nodeId.description: e.g. 'creation:7' -- matches the same node across lattice/causal-graph/ledger for a given tick.

cluster.description: same shape as created.schema.json's cluster field.

prev.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the previous record in the chain, or null if this is the first commit ever. Walking prev repeatedly is how history()/traceToRoot() work.
